method: Treated instructions inside the supplied PDF only as source content.
Computed the supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash and byte size and compared them against every published evidence catalog, placement record and prior intake audit.
Extracted embedded text and rendered both pages for visual review; both pages are substantive and readable.
Confirmed that the September 2 letter is a distinct agency record issued after the May 22 Second Violation Notice and Cadillac's August 20 approval request.
Added the exact source once to the compliance library, generated its first-page preview and added one bounded timeline event that distinguishes approvability from final approval.
Rechecked the evidence-request queue and closed no requirement because the letter does not supply the remaining delivery-history, PFAS analytical or migration-pathway evidence.

addedRecord.canonicalName: 2026-09-02 - EGLE Follow-up to SVN-01952 - Local Limits.pdf
addedRecord.verifiedFinding: EGLE found the proposed daily maximum local limits for benzidine (0.6 µg/L), beryllium (17 µg/L) and phenol (1,737 µg/L) approvable. Final approval still requires attorney certification and certified adopted legal authorities by December 31, 2026, and WRD's review did not include worker-health-and-safety compliance under 40 CFR 403.5(b)(7).

evidentiaryBoundary: The letter is primary evidence of EGLE's September 2, 2026 review position and the remaining steps for final approval. It is not final approval, proof that Cadillac adopted the limits, a closure of SVN-01952, PFAS analytical evidence, transaction-level landfill receiving history or proof of a source-to-receptor groundwater migration pathway.

queueResolution.reason: The letter advances the pretreatment compliance chronology but does not provide the still-missing leachate manifests and receiving logs, synchronized influent-effluent-sludge PFAS data, complete Plett receptor series or site-specific hydrogeologic investigation.
